dispositions.name: totk-pc-recomp
dispositions.reason: The README describes a native recompilation of one existing game, not a reusable game engine or real-time 3D framework. Decline this arena placement independently of the unresolved popularity anomaly. No claim of manipulated stars or nonfunctional software is made.
evidence: https://github.com/valentderah/totk-pc-recomp — README reviewed 2026-11-04; Windows/Linux recompilation of Tears of the Kingdom requiring user-supplied game data. No downloaded code executed.
